name: Bruised Ribs

effects.text: +1 Difficulty on the next MOVE test

healTime: Ends after a scene of rest.
healBy: Ends after a scene of rest.

name: Deep Cut
healTime: Medical care; Field Surgery clears it immediately.
healBy: Medical care; Field Surgery clears it immediately.
text: A blade has opened you up.

name: Shield Burn

effects.text: Gain WOUNDED; +1 Difficulty to BATTLE while shielded

text: A shield field feedback or a lasgun graze has seared your skin.

name: Slow Poison
healTime: Antidote kit or a Suk doctor.
healBy: Antidote kit or a Suk doctor.
text: A poison you did not notice is working on you.

name: Residual Poison

effects.text: Gain POISONED and INDEBTED to whoever holds the antidote

healTime: The one specific antidote, administered regularly.
healBy: The one specific antidote, administered regularly.
text: A poison that only kills if its antidote is withheld. Someone now controls your life.

name: Cracked Stillsuit

effects.text: Gain DEHYDRATED at the end of the next scene unless repaired

healTime: Stillsuit repair kit or a sietch workshop.
healBy: Stillsuit repair kit or a sietch workshop.
text: Your suit is leaking water with every step.

name: Severe Water Loss

effects.text: Gain DEHYDRATED; another dehydration consequence takes you out

healTime: Two litres of water and a day sealed in shade.
healBy: Two litres of water and a day sealed in shade.
text: You are drying out faster than you can drink.

name: Sunstroke
healTime: Shade, water and a night of rest.
healBy: Shade, water and a night of rest.

name: Sand-Blasted
healTime: Clean water and a day out of the glare.
healBy: Clean water and a day out of the glare.
text: A storm has scoured your eyes and skin.

name: Lost in the Deep Desert

effects.text: Gain EXPOSED; each day without rescue adds a dehydration consequence

healTime: Find landmarks (UNDERSTAND D3) or be found.
healBy: Find landmarks (UNDERSTAND D3) or be found.
text: You no longer know where you are, and the water is running out.

name: Public Humiliation
text: Your failure was seen by the wrong people.

name: Exposed Secret

effects.text: Gain SUSPECTED; the Narrator gains 2 Threat

text: Something you hid is now known by a rival.

name: Broken Oath

effects.text: Gain DISGRACED and lose your Drive statement until you atone

healTime: A significant act of atonement chosen with the Narrator.
healBy: A significant act of atonement chosen with the Narrator.
text: You were forced to break your word. Your House or tribe has noticed.

name: Maimed

effects.text: Permanently +1 Difficulty on tests using the lost part

healTime: Only an expensive prosthetic or Bene Tleilax regrowth.
healBy: Only an expensive prosthetic or Bene Tleilax regrowth.
text: A lasting injury: a hand, an eye, a crippled knee.

name: Mortal Wound

effects.text: Taken out; you die at the end of the scene without surgery

healTime: Surgery: UNDERSTAND (D3) by someone with a medical kit.
healBy: Surgery: UNDERSTAND (D3) by someone with a medical kit.

name: Fatal Poison

effects.text: Taken out; you die in minutes unless the exact antidote is given

healTime: The exact antidote, or a Bene Gesserit transmuting the poison within.
healBy: The exact antidote, or a Bene Gesserit transmuting the poison within.
text: A poison that kills within minutes.
